description: The catalog of deck screens: the basic catalog of A2UI and the blocks of deck as components of their own. A block's data is at the path of its data property: {state, error?, filters?, rows | items | value | lines}. block is the form a manifest stores the block in; its refs are the $defs of the manifest schema.

basic.description: The standard components of A2UI a screen is drawn with besides the blocks of deck; a container block of a manifest is drawn by one of them, the server translates it.

block.description: Holds at least one block in blocks, side by side; nothing else.

dialog.description: A button that opens its blocks in a window over the screen; ?dialog=<name> in the address of the screen opens it too, and a form in it closes it once its call went through.
dialog.drawn: Modal with a Button of a Text that opens it

block.description: Needs title (the label of its button), name and at least one block in blocks; primary paints its button in the accent.
Holds its tabs in tabs, each with a title and at least one block; nothing else.

dialogs.description: The dialogs of the screen, Modals whose buttons stand beside its title.

key.description: Of a tab of Tabs: its title as written, its name in the address in every language.

name.description: Of the window of a Modal: the name of its dialog, ?dialog=<name> in the address opens it.

spans.description: The cells of the grid a standard child narrower than the screen takes, by its id.

topics.description: Of the root screen: the event topics after which the client reads it again; it ignores the others.

block.description: Needs source and columns (each a label and bind, an expression over the row); filter and actions are optional. The first columns are the main ones: a line shows four (two on a phone), the rest, and the details of a column, open in the row under it; a column every row leaves empty is not drawn; a tag column takes its details as the hint of its badge.

pick.description: The button of each row whose pick is the same is the one the cell picks the input of.

block.description: Needs source and item, whose title, text and meta are expressions over each item; filter and actions are optional.

item.description: Expressions of each line; details is text shown in full on demand, questions what the owner answers in a picker.

since.description: Expression giving an ISO 8601 time the line counts from, such as started_at; shown beside meta as how long ago, kept fresh.

icon.description: Expression giving the name of a Tabler icon of the line.

kind.description: Expression giving what a line is, such as a question or a new right, said in the head of its card in a focus list.

board.description: An enum field of the module's collection the list reads: the list is a board with a lane for each value of the enum, in order and in the owner's language; dragging an item to a lane presses its button whose input is that field with the value of the lane, and on a phone that button picks the lane.

cards.description: The items stand side by side as cards instead of lines, such as the modules of a workspace; not with board.

focus.description: The items go one at a time: the first a big card with its kind and its place among them, the next two behind it, and a button Later that puts the one shown last on this device; for a queue the owner goes through, such as decisions. Not with cards or board.

head.description: Buttons in the head of the list, such as one that reads all its notes; their when and their label of an expression read rows, the items of its source.

data.description: items: [{id, title, text, meta, image, details, questions, lane, kind, actions}], board: {field, lanes}, head: the buttons of its head

card.description: Fields of the record of a record page.

block.description: Shows the record of a record page; takes no source, only fields and actions; a field with no value (null or empty text) is not shown; a field with markdown shows its value as markdown.

bind.description: Expression over the fields of the record.

stat.description: One value over the items of a source.

block.description: Needs source; value is an expression over rows, len(rows) by default. With empty, a source without items shows that text instead of the value, so value can be rows[0].price with no len(rows) > 0 ? ... : '—'; a value that is null is empty too.

value.description: Expression over rows, the items of the source, such as len(rows) or sum(rows, .amount); len(rows) by default.

tone.description: Expression over rows that gives ok, warn, error or muted; any other value is no tone.

actions.description: A click on the stat opens the screen of its first button that opens one, such as the list of what it counts.

data.description: value: a number or a text

chart.description: A line or bar chart of the items of a source: one point per item, in the order of the sort of the source.

block.description: Needs source, x and series; x and each y are expressions over an item, a null y is a gap in the line. At most the last 500 points by the sort of the source are drawn; limit keeps the first items of the sort, so a long history is cut by the chart, not by limit. format and currency show the y values; an x that is an ISO 8601 time makes a time axis.

x.description: Expression over an item: the value on the x axis, such as at.

y.description: Expression over an item: the value of the series, such as price.

media.description: Files of the items of a source of any format: one in place (a picture that opens in full, a PDF, a video or a sound in the browser's own player, the start of a text, an HTML or SVG page in a frame that runs nothing, any other file by its type, name and size with a download); several as tiles or a list the owner switches on the device, which open in a lightbox one after another.

block.description: Needs item.file, an expression over an item of its source, or on a record page without a source over the record itself: the id of a stored file of the project (a result of its process, an attachment of its record) or a path in the data folder of the project; item.title is the caption. A line whose item.file is empty or null is a tile of its item.icon, such as a folder or a document, that presses its primary button; with folders and files of a folder together, the block is a file manager. A file of another project or a path that is no file of the data folder is an error of its line, not of the block. A player with marks on its timeline is a custom block (MCP Apps) that reads the file through resources/read of deck://data/<path>. A single picture takes the width of the block.

icon.description: Expression giving the Tabler icon of a line that names no file, such as a folder or a document: its tile presses the primary button of the line.

path.description: An expression over the params of the screen giving the folder a file manager shows, such as param.path: the block shows it as steps from the root of the folder, each opening its folder by the primary button of a folder line with that path, and a step up.

actions.description: Buttons of each file, over its item, as the buttons of a row of a table.

data.description: files: [{id, title, name, type, size, url, actions}, {id, title, icon, actions} or {id, title, error}]

actions.description: A group of buttons without a source.

block.description: Needs actions; takes no source. The buttons past a few wait in its own menu.

data.description: value: the buttons, with the record of the page in their params

log.description: The log of the process of a record page.

block.description: Needs source, deck.process_chat of the process; takes nothing else.

data.description: lines: [{at, kind, id, title, status, text, delete}], newest first; since and say while it runs

form.description: Asks for the input of a command and shows its result: one command, or a pick from deck.commands_list.

block.description: Has either command or source from deck.commands_list to pick one, never both; it is its own button and takes no actions.

command.description: deck.record_update on a record page edits the record.

keep_open.description: In a dialog the form stays open after its call to show the result, such as a token shown once; otherwise the dialog closes.

fixed.description: Fields of values the form does not show and sends as they are, such as the id of the record of the page.

values.description: Fields filled before the owner types, by field: fixed text, or =<expression> over the record of the page such as =title or =param.<name>, a parameter the screen declares.

choices.description: Values offered for fields of the input, by field: a source and expressions over its items for the value and its label.

data.description: value: {commands: [{name, title, project, input, result}], values, fixed, readonly, record}

appearance.description: How deck looks on the device: theme, color scheme, accent, surfaces, density, font size, corners; with part pushes, the pushes of the device.

block.description: Only on deck's own screens; takes no source; part picks the look (by default) or the pushes of the device.

data.description: the client keeps the look; the data is only its state

document.description: A document of the project: its text, markdown drawn, edited as text when it is md, its revisions and going back to one.

block.description: Names the document in document; on a record page it is a document of the record, else of the project. A document page shows its own document and takes no field.

data.description: value: {id, project, name, kind, text, revision, editable, record, revisions}

custom.description: An MCP App: HTML of a custom/ document, fed by its source, pressing only its buttons.

block.description: Needs document, a custom/ document with its HTML; its buttons call commands, app.openLink opens a screen or dialog of deck (never a page outside), app.requestDisplayMode fullscreen gives it the whole screen, app.readServerResource({uri}) reads a file of its module whole (up to 200 MB) as contents[0].blob in base64 with its mimeType — deck://data/<path> of its data folder or deck://file/<id> a stored file, never one of another module; it shows one as a blob: or data: URL, the network stays closed.

params.description: Settings the block is given beside its items, by name: fixed text, or =<expression> over the record of the page such as =title or =param.<name>; one HTML serves several screens.

chat.description: The chat with the master: the topics, the messages of one, the master's questions in it and the turn going on, with send, stop, archive and delete.

block.description: Needs source deck.chat and no other field; the client picks the topic as the filter topic of the block: a topic id, new for a new one, empty for the newest.

tone.description: How a value stands: ok, warn, error or muted.

action.description: A button: a command call or a move to a screen. verb names a built-in label the client translates.

icon.description: Name of a Tabler icon on the button.

input.description: Param the owner types before the call.

until.description: Time after which the button is hidden.

class.description: Class of the command of a custom block's button; the host asks the owner before one that is not internal.

from_block.description: The fields a custom block's call fills beside params; the host refuses any other.

from_items.description: The fields of from_block that name a record: the host takes only the id of an item of the block or of the record of its page.

confirm.description: The client asks the owner before the call: a button of deck that deletes or revokes.

hold.description: The call goes a few seconds after the press, while a note on the screen offers to take it back; for an answer the owner may change their mind about, such as a decision.

parts.description: With confirm, a read command the client calls with params and lists before the yes: what the call deletes for good, as kind and name; the yes waits until the list came.

options.description: Values the owner picks the input from.

labels.description: Each option in the owner's language, when one differs from its value.

pick.description: The table column with the same pick draws the button as a picker of its options in the cell.

chat.description: With a command, the result names a chat topic, which the client opens; alone, the button opens the chat of the master in a new topic.

download.description: With a command, the result names a stored file (file), which the client downloads.

undo.description: The call that takes this one back; the client offers it for a moment after the call went through.

values.description: The value of the data of each block that has one, by component.

fixed.description: Values of fields the form does not show and sends as they are

send.description: How the form calls its command when not with its fields as the input: its params with the fields as the JSON of its input field

id.description: 0 while the document is not written yet

size.description: Bytes of the text, given in its place to a viewer other than the owner

save.description: Of an editable document: saves its text, with the text, the reason and if_revision filled in

revert.description: Of an editable document: goes back to this revision

params.description: The params of the block, resolved

project.description: The module whose files the block reads; none on a screen of deck

size.description: Bytes of the HTML, given in its place to a viewer other than the owner

files.description: the files the owner attached, or that the reply and the processes it started made

thumb.description: the light copy of a picture, shown small; the file itself only in a viewer

color.description: the main color of the picture, shown while it loads

screen.description: the screen the owner wrote it on: project, screen, record, process

delete.description: takes back a message of the owner no reply took yet

work.description: how a reply of the master went

subscription_usd.description: what its calls on a subscription would cost, an estimate

word.description: the state in the owner's words

waits.description: it waits for the owner or its provider rather than works

started_at.description: when the reply last started work

word.description: the state in the owner's words

waits.description: it waits for the owner or its provider rather than works

word.description: the state in the owner's words

waits.description: it waits for the owner or its provider rather than works

models.description: the models the master's replies may go on

model.description: the master's own model, which a topic without one takes

suggest.description: of a topic without messages: commands of the module of the owner's screen, as texts to put in the field

asks.description: what the turn going on and the processes it started wait for the owner to decide, its questions apart: items of deck.asks_list with their buttons

project.description: the project of the screen of its first message

model.description: the model its replies go on, when the owner picked one

word.description: the state in the owner's words

waits.description: it waits for the owner or its provider rather than works

cut.description: what a reply that broke off or the owner stopped left

stopped.description: the owner stopped it; its one retry goes on on its own provider

reason.description: why it broke off, in words

steps.description: the calls of tools it made

did.description: the calls it made that act, in order

retry.description: a button per provider it can go again on

empty.description: the text of an empty block

filters.description: Choices the owner narrows the block by; the client sends the picked ones back to deck.screen.

label.description: the field in the owner's language

labels.description: each option in the owner's language, when one differs

tones.description: the tone of each cell, null for none

details.description: the text of each cell shown in full on demand, null for none; such a cell shows its value in one line

head.description: the buttons in the head of a list

board.description: the lanes of a board: the field of its items and the values of its enum with their labels

lane.description: the value of the board field of the item

since.description: the time the line counts from, shown as how long ago

kind.description: what the item is, said in the head of its card in a focus list

more.description: how many items the limit of the source left out of a list or a table

actions.description: The buttons of a stat; a click on it runs the first that opens a screen.

url.description: where the client reads the file, with its token

thumb.description: the light copy of a picture, shown small; the file itself only in a viewer

color.description: the main color of the picture, shown while it loads

icon.description: the icon of a line that is no file; its tile presses the primary button

crumbs.description: the steps of the folder a file manager shows, its root first, each with the button that opens it

lines.description: the log of a process, newest first

delete.description: deletes a message of the owner the agent has not taken

since.description: when a process still going started

say.description: writes to the agent of a process still going
